newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Bond Commission approves 13 issues.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Bond Commission approves 13 issues.

text.p: Louisiana Bond Commission gave final approval Thursday to 13 bond issues totalling nearly $147 million.
--$40 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority revenue and refunding bonds for the Woman's Hosptital Foundation Project in Baton Rouge.
--$30 million East Baton Rouge Mortgage Finance Authority single family mortgage revenue refunding bonds.
--$26 million City of Shreveport airport revenue bonds.
--$12.5 million Calcasieu Parish Public Trust Authority single family mortgage revenue bonds.
--$8.485 million Calcasieu Parish Law Enforcement District special corrections facility revenue refunding bonds.
--$7.5 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority revenue bonds for campus housing at Tulane University.
--$7.5 million Lafayette Economic Development Authority variable rate revenue bonds for the Lomal Company to to build and equip a manufacturing plant near the city of Vatican.
--$6 million Like Oak Multi-Faith Trust mortgage revenue and refunding bonds.
--$3.8 million Iberville Parish Police Jury public building refunding bonds.
--$2 million Lafayette Parish Waterworks District North water revenue refunding bonds.
--$1.33 million Lafayette Economic Development Authority taxable certificiates of indebtedness to aquire sites and build industrial parks.
--$1 million St. Landry Parish Economic and Industrial Development District taxable revenue bonds for a Wall Mart warehouse and distribution facility.
--$700,000 Town of Iota sewer revenue bonds, and a $700,000 bond anticipation note of up to 24 months.
